import json
src='''def transform(g):
    n=len(g)
    def maps():
        return [lambda i,j:(i,j),
                lambda i,j:(j,i),
                lambda i,j:(j,n-1-i),
                lambda i,j:(n-1-i,n-1-j),
                lambda i,j:(n-1-j,i),
                lambda i,j:(n-1-i,j),
                lambda i,j:(i,n-1-j),
                lambda i,j:(n-1-j,n-1-i)]
    M=maps()
    def fill(c):
        out=[row[:] for row in g]
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n):
                if out[i][j]==c:
                    vals=[g[a][b] for m in M for a,b in [m(i,j)] if g[a][b]!=c]
                    out[i][j]=vals[0] if vals else c
        return out
    def dihsym(x):
        return all(x[a][b]==x[i][j] for i in range(n) for j in range(n) for m in M for a,b in [m(i,j)])
    for c in sorted(set(v for r in g for v in r)):
        f=fill(c)
        if dihsym(f): return f
    return g
'''
